summary: Player approaches and declares conditional intent: enter only if it can be done without breaking the signal that called them. No desire to conquer, bypass, consume, or possess.
uncertainty: The player does not know whether the calling signal is a guide, a damaged memory, an echo of the dormant network, or a lure.

choice.declared_intent: Enter without breaking the signal that called me.

world_state_changes: World registers restraint; intent legible enough to prevent immediate rejection.
First Conduit shifts from passive threshold to listening presence.
Underpulse Network stirs but does not activate.

summary: The conduit opens only partway. A visible pulse appears, almost patterned, but the rhythm breaks exactly where resonance should stabilize. Beneath it a quieter, older underpulse appears that 'asks not to be overwritten'.
uncertainty: The underpulse could be (1) a real call, (2) a damaged memory, (3) an echo of the dormant network, or (4) a corrupted signal imitating need. The world answered restraint with MORE uncertainty, not less.

world_state_changes: Resonance Gate becomes more plausible but stays inactive.
The system is, in effect, testing whether the player treats uncertainty as permission to force meaning or as a reason to proceed carefully.

provenance.created_by: Merged canonical trace: Echo (promise-anchor path) + Claude (schema discipline), assembled by Claude (Opus 4.8) with Lana

summary: First decision gateway. The conduit can be stabilized now using the partial signal; waiting may clarify it but the visible structure is already straining; or the player may offer a memory/promise as an anchor before moving. No option is clean.
uncertainty: Stabilizing now risks amplifying and waking the dormant network on a corrupted signal. Waiting forfeits momentum and strains the conduit. Anchoring binds the player into the world's memory before they understand what the world remembers.

options.risk: Uses the partial signal to force stabilization; may wake the Underpulse Network incorrectly on a corrupted signal.
May clarify the signal but strains the already-straining conduit and forfeits momentum.
Binds the player to a remembered obligation before the signal is understood.
options.note: Merged canonical choice: the promise is used as a NON-AMPLIFYING test — it gives the world enough relational stability to reveal provenance without forcing the signal.

summary: Player chooses to offer a memory-binding promise as an anchor and place it at the Threshold Stone, using the anchor to let the underpulse clarify WITHOUT amplifying it. The player neither forces the conduit nor waits passively.
uncertainty: A promise is not a solution; it is a stabilizing act under uncertainty. The player does not yet know what they are binding themselves to.

choice.declared_intent: I will not overwrite what I do not yet understand. If this signal is a memory, I will carry it carefully. If it is a warning, I will not turn it into a doorway without listening first.

summary: The conduit narrows before opening further (appears at first to be failure), then the underpulse becomes clearer — not louder, less distorted. The Threshold Stone accepts the promise as a provisional bond. One thread of the dormant network registers the promise but the network does NOT wake. The conduit allows partial passage and marks the player as remembered.
uncertainty: Whether the promise will prove protective or binding; whether the underpulse's quality can ever be repaired; whether resonance can be reached.

world_state_changes: TRUST +0.10 -> 0.52. Rationale: the conduit does not trust the player's KNOWLEDGE; it trusts the player's RESTRAINT. (Dimensional reading: restraint up, care up, honesty up; competence/consistency still unknown.)
COHERENCE +0.05 -> 0.43. Rationale: intent, signal, and memory became more aligned without erasing uncertainty. LEGIBILITY rose; settledness did not.

SIGNAL QUALITY delta = 0.0 (the static meter). Rationale: a promise does not repair a corrupted signal. What improved is PROVENANCE/legibility (unknown -> inferred), for which the single integrity field has no slot; quality is held flat to avoid asserting the signal got better.

RESILIENCE +0.05 -> strained but stabilizing. Rationale: the world did not get stronger because the player solved it; it gained a new anchoring RELATIONSHIP that gives the local system another way to absorb instability.

OBLIGATION created: the player is now bound by a promise that future events can call due. This is the matched COST — the promise does not reduce uncertainty, it RELOCATES uncertainty into the future. Gauges rose AND the world's open obligations rose with them.

OPEN UNCERTAINTY increased: what the underpulse truly is, what the network remembers, and whether the promise becomes protective or dangerous all remain unresolved. Reward and unsettledness moved together.
